A first look at a dataset

Source: R/read.R
store_glimpse.Rd

Prints what the catalog says about a dataset (kind, rows, files, version, key, partition, coordinate reference system) and the first rows of its first file, read from one row group. Opens one file. For a raster, the terra::SpatRaster is printed instead, with its categories and colours as store_read() returns them.

Usage

store_glimpse(st, dataset)

Arguments

st

A store connection made by store_connect().

dataset

Name of the dataset: the full name, or its last part when that is unique in the store.

Value

The rows shown (a tibble, or an sf object for geospatial data), invisibly; for a raster, the terra::SpatRaster, invisibly.

See also

store_read(), store_describe().

Examples

location <- file.path(tempdir(), "rcs-example-glimpse")
st <- store_connect(location, create = TRUE)
store_write(st, rcs_sim_table(500), "sales/daily",
  title = "Daily sales", description = "Simulated daily sales.",
  key = c("shop_id", "date", "product"), partition = "year"
)
#> ℹ Writing "sales/daily": 500 rows in 2 files (partition year).
#> ✔ primary  /tmp/Rtmp/rcs-example-glimpse  2/2
#>   files sent  38.3 kB  0.1s
#> ✔ MD5 identical for 2 files in 1 location. Catalogs updated.
store_glimpse(st, "daily")
